methods.name: DistMult
methods.description: A knowledge graph embedding model designed as a parametrized scoring function that maps an input triple (h,r,t) to a scalar value.

methods.name: KD-Rel-DistMult
methods.description: Kronecker Decomposition applied on relation embeddings of DistMult, defined as KD-Rel-DistMult(h,r,t) = h ◦ (r ⊗ r) · t.
